decisions.evidence: Across the six neighbors, all three mutagenic neighbors and even the three non-mutagenic neighbors point in the same direction: the query carries an azo group, is smaller and less lipophilic than several of the analogs, and shows a pattern of physicochemical shifts that does not convincingly move it away from the mutagenic analogs. The negative-neighbor comparisons are not actually protective enough to outweigh the repeated azo-linked signal, so the combined evidence supports option (B): is mutagenic.
